NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author force-pushed twice, but only reworded the commit subject to be shorter. The code is the same size and touches the same files. They then asked whether it's okay now.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌  | The commit subject is still not in Zulip style. It has no space after `web:`, the text after the colon isn't capitalized, there is no trailing period, and it uses abbreviations ("nav", "dm"). |
| ❌  | The commit has no message body explaining what changed and why, even though the checklist item for this is ticked. |
| ✅  | The question about the other open PR for this issue (#40027) was answered, and the PR is otherwise complete with a description, testing notes and videos. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the commit message, since no code changes are needed.

###### Reply

```quote
Not quite yet. Please compare your commit message against the [commit message guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages): the subject needs a space after the prefix, a capitalized summary, and a trailing period, and the commit needs a body that explains what changed and why. Looking at recent merged commits in the same area is a good way to see the expected style.
```
